critique.evidence: The screen has a clear demo-worthy visual thesis: the oversized two-line contradiction (“The signature is valid. The intent was stolen.”) is paired with a forensic evidence trail whose cyan and red paths visibly diverge between intent, retrieved page, and verified payment. The labeled artifact cards, restrained neon palette, and “AUTHENTIC ≠ INTENDED” endpoint make the core idea recognizable across desktop, tablet, and mobile rather than reading as a generic KPI dashboard.
critique.fix: Push the signature metaphor one step further with a more explicit animated or visually continuous trace from recorded intent through page manipulation to payment; the current connector lines become fragmented on mobile, slightly weakening the signature visual at the smallest viewport.
